Saudi Arabia Plans Houthi Offensive for Red Sea Control

Saudi Arabia is reportedly planning an offensive operation against Houthi forces to retake the Bab el-Mandeb strait and secure shipping lanes in the Red Sea. The operation aims to break the Houthi "chokehold" on the vital waterway.
